source: The default scene (852 nm tweezer along x, probe, B = 3 G) with the tweezer at 0.02 mW (a trap about 5 uK deep) and the atom at 200 uK, 100 us and 21 samples on the CPU, as the app sends it: the validation of v2026.11.3.2 (claude/validate-3d, repro/F4_total_loss.json). No atom is bound at t = 0: every one is lost at the first step.
